UPDATE b_marketing_tcyr_sync a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b1.cust_num, b1.cell FROM b_marketing_sync_${apiCode} b1 INNER JOIN ( -- 找到每个 cust_num 对应的最大 id SELECT cust_num, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM b_marketing_sync_${apiCode} GROUP BY cust_num ) b2 ON b1.cust_num = b2.cust_num AND b1.id = b2.max_id ) latest_b ON a.user_key = latest_b.cust_num SET a.cell = CASE WHEN latest_b.cust_num IS NOT NULL THEN latest_b.cell ELSE a.cell END, a.is_match = CASE WHEN latest_b.cust_num IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.is_clean = 0 WHERE a.is_match IS NULL ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT 2000;
